name: open-source-release R-6: AppImage GPL guard node:test suite passes against the real build-appimage.sh
summary: The seven AppImage GPL guard tests pass (7 pass, 0 fail). They run the real GST_GPL_PLUGINS drop loop and the GST_GPL_LIB_ERE guard block extracted from papercusp-desktop/bin/build-appimage.sh (sha256 25544975aac753e8553425e06df7f11299e279c6e26f9b59a6d0a83b13181eae, papercusp-desktop HEAD 93c498aa21c021ba98d736269df985777c8bf2c2) against fixture AppDirs. The build drops every GPL-only GStreamer plugin and fails when a library on the GPL-only list reaches the AppDir. Re-run 2026-09-30T10:40:42Z against papercusp-desktop@e54ad781bbdf after build-appimage.sh changed: exit 0, pass 7 fail 0.

assertions.evidence: The test slices GST_GPL_PLUGINS= ... done and GST_GPL_LIB_ERE= ... 'GPL library guard: no GPL codec/media libraries in the AppDir' out of bin/build-appimage.sh at run time. There is no re-implementation.
